title: ImageAnnotation
description: The labels of one benchmark photo. Points are in pixels of the image as stored, before any rotation from its orientation tag: x to the right, y down, (0, 0) at the top-left corner of the top-left pixel. Every label records how it was made.

annotation_version.description: The version of this annotation format

image_id.description: The photo's benchmark name without its extension, as in the session manifest

image_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the benchmark file the labels were made on

case_outline.description: The outer edge of the case seen from above (the bezel's edge where it is outermost)

dial_outline.description: The edge of the visible dial opening

points.description: Points on the edge, in order around it. Five or more, so an ellipse is determined

radial.description: The skin edge on the thumb side, across the watch's position

ulnar.description: The skin edge on the little-finger side, across the watch's position

glare.description: A reflection hides part of the case or dial

occluded.description: Something covers part of the watch or the wrist

strap_moved.description: The watch sits away from its usual place

unusable.description: Leave this photo out of every measurement

method.description: How the label was made. Only the first three were checked by a person

labeller.description: The person who drew, accepted or corrected the label, by participant ID; null when no person checked it

proposer.description: The model or algorithm, with its version, that proposed the label; null when a person drew it

tool.description: The tool and version that saved the label

created.description: When the label was saved, with its time zone
